acceptance: RED first: TestObserver_TheNudgeAsksForAFindingWhenThePhaseAddedNoBoardEntry fails before the change.
A phase that added a board entry gets the current nudge body.

fix: When the phase has added no board entry at the nudge, send a nudge body that also asks for a FACT or FAIL entry. Both bodies are observer policy values, not code. The stall threshold does not change.
summary: The observer already nudges once at 300 s idle and stalls at 600 s (go/internal/policy/dispatch.go:61, go/internal/observerengine/tick.go:87). Agensh adds a reminder when a turn adds no board entry. Research §2.4 P2.8, §3 F3.5.
title: The idle nudge also asks for a FACT or FAIL board entry when the phase has added none.
